walls.note: North (downstream, IJ side) face from the boat panorama, rectified at 20 px/m (artifacts/bridges/BRU0236/photo-m.jpg); details from the Commons photographs of the same face.

items.where: four polished red granite columns per face (two on the pier prows, two on the abutment ends) on stepped stone pedestals, Ionic capital, polychrome imperial crown, a ship form halfway up carrying double lanterns
items.how: builder pylon(): stepped pedestal boxes, lathe shaft (red), lathe capital, lathe gilt crown with orb and cross, ellipsoid rostral boat with two prow beams, two lantern arms with dark-framed ochre lanterns

items.where: both piers end in carved stone ship bows: a hull with a gunwale and chain garland, a female figurehead, a bundle of oars, a fish/dolphin under the bow, a volute at the stern, a mooring ring on the cutwater
items.how: builder: pointed cutwater prism, hull prism, gunwale band, figurehead ellipsoid, dolphin ellipsoid, three oar beams, stern volute torus, iron mooring ring torus; the chain garland is folded into the gunwale band

items.where: a keystone with a sculpted head at the crown of each side arch
items.how: builder: keystone box 22 cm proud with an ellipsoid head

items.where: two segmental side arches with a moulded ring
items.how: builder: segmental arc spandrel wall, 45 cm ring 7 cm proud, barrel soffit

items.where: three round-headed slots and two roundels in each spandrel beside the springings
items.how: builder: dark slot panels with round heads and dark roundels in stone rings, 6-9 cm proud

items.where: white limestone vase balustrade on a plinth with dados, broken by the column pedestals
items.how: builder: plinth and handrail swept along the deck profile, dados every <=3.2 m, turned balusters every ~0.33 m

items.where: flat central span: girder face with a recessed panel band, Amsterdam shields and garlands
items.how: builder: girder wall following the deck, proud panel band, four red shields with a dark pale; garlands folded into the panel band

items.where: cornice band under the balustrade along the whole face
items.how: builder: band swept along the deck profile, 15 cm proud

items.where: red brick abutments with stone quoins where the side arches spring
items.how: builder: brick block with stacked stone quoins
